summary.content:
Today's selection covers 85 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI agents get rebrand - as 'dots' - while safety worries delay new model
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Former US Air Force members sent to prison over BEC attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 69 articles published in the last 24 hours
